attributes.name: userId
attributes.description: Keeper enterprise user_id (stable numeric ID as string)

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary email address; used as the account identifier

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full name as stored in Keeper

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Keeper enterprise user status (Invited, Active, Locked, etc.)

attributes.name: accountStatus
attributes.description: Keeper enterprise user status (Invited, Active, Locked)

attributes.name: jobTitle
attributes.description: Job title

attributes.name: twoFactorEnabled
attributes.description: Whether 2FA is enabled on the vault

attributes.name: aliases
attributes.description: Alternate email aliases

attributes.name: node
attributes.description: Enterprise node the user belongs to (single-valued entitlement). Required on create because Keeper enterprise users must be placed in a node.

attributes.name: teams
attributes.description: Team memberships (team_uid values)

attributes.name: roles
attributes.description: Direct role memberships (role_id values)

attributes.name: folders
attributes.description: Folder entitlements as <folderUid>:<permission> for whoami-catalog folders only (classic: whoami has MU; NSF: whoami has OW). Classic: NP|MU|MR|MUR. NSF: V|SM|CM|CSM|FM.

attributes.name: records
attributes.description: Classic/NSF records shared directly to this user.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: node_id (stable numeric ID as string)

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Node display name

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Full node path (e.g. Metron Security\Dev Node2)

attributes.name: parentId
attributes.description: Parent node_id

attributes.name: parentPath
attributes.description: Parent node path

attributes.name: isolated
attributes.description: Whether the node is isolated

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: team_uid

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Team display name

attributes.name: nodeId
attributes.description: Owning node_id

attributes.name: nodePath
attributes.description: Owning node path

attributes.name: restricts
attributes.description: Raw Keeper restrict flags (e.g. '  W S'); decoded attributes may be added later

attributes.name: folders
attributes.description: Folder entitlements shared to this team as <folderUid>:<permission> for whoami-catalog folders only (classic MU / NSF OW). Classic: NP|MU|MR|MUR. NSF: V|SM|CM|CSM|FM.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: role_id (stable numeric ID as string)

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Role display name

attributes.name: nodeId
attributes.description: Owning node_id

attributes.name: nodePath
attributes.description: Owning node path

attributes.name: admin
attributes.description: Whether this is an administrator role

attributes.name: defaultRole
attributes.description: Whether the role is assigned to new users by default

attributes.name: visibleBelow
attributes.description: Whether the role is visible to child nodes

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Folder entitlement id: <folderUid>:<permission>. Classic NP|MU|MR|MUR. NSF V|SM|CM|CSM|FM

attributes.name: uid
attributes.description: Raw Keeper folder UID (without permission suffix)

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Folder name with permission label, e.g. New Demo [Manage records]

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Folder path (same for all permissions of one folder)

attributes.name: folderType
attributes.description: classic or nsf

attributes.name: parentId
attributes.description: Parent folder UID (absent for vault root children)

attributes.name: permission
attributes.description: Permission code. Classic: NP, MU, MR, MUR. NSF: V, SM, CM, CSM, FM

attributes.name: permissionLabel
attributes.description: Human-readable permission label

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Composite entitlement id: {record_uid}:{permission} (e.g. abc123:edit)

attributes.name: displayName
attributes.description: Assignment UI label formatted as '{name} [{permission}]' (e.g. Payroll DB [edit])

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Keeper record title only (no permission suffix)

attributes.name: record_uid
attributes.description: Keeper record UID only

attributes.name: permission
attributes.description: Share right level (e.g. view, edit, share) — mapped to Keeper share flags

attributes.name: record_category
attributes.description: Record source (classic / nsf)

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Keeper record type

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Keeper record path
